FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

2. When practising Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Comprehension.

3. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Excuse me
   C. Good night only
   D. Thank you

4. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.

5. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.

6. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

7. When practising Reading for Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Vocabulary.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Vocabulary.

8. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.

9. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. porte
   B. livre
   C. chaise
   D. fenêtre

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension.

3. A — Good morning / hello

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
